Sovereign Stack

1. YOUR MACHINE — or your robot. No cloud. No API key.

2. LOOPBACK RUNTIME — Node 22+. No outbound telemetry. No provider dependency.

3. VAULT — scrypt → AES-256-GCM. Your keys only.

4. GATE — Approval expires in 1 minute. Editing invalidates.

5. RECEIPT — SHA-256. Hash-linked. Witnessed. Public.

6. YOU HOLD THE EVIDENCE — No one else can sign for you.

Policy gives you rights. The kernel gives you keys. — The gap · soværeign.com

Sovereign Kernel · Invariants
1. Private intention stays in memory
What you think before you act is yours alone. The vault does not export intent.
2. Approval bound to digest + session + operation + expiry
An approval is a cryptographic object, not a feeling. Editing invalidates. Expiry: 1 minute.
3. Public projection allowlisted
What becomes public is what you chose to publish. No telemetry. No exfil.
4. Receipts are SHA-256
Every action produces a hash-linked receipt. The chain is the proof.
5. Default-deny
No capability fires without the gate. The gate is the human.
